description: Processed empirical observation for the non-proliferating (pupal-wing) experiment. Summaries are computed from 23 segmented Drosophila pupal-wing images at 16.5--18.5 h after puparium formation (Yan et al.; segmentations as in Ogita et al.). This is the observational target x_o used for inference; it is not a model-simulated truth.
source_images: Yan2025 / Ogita2022 w165- sample set (VDat outlines)

files.x_o_w165_out5d.npy: shape (5,); observation used for MF-SBI / HF baselines in the paper
files.x_o_w165_out6d.npy: shape (6,); observation used when matching theta_hat
